evidence.quote: Study Intelligent Mechatronic Systems in English
Tuition fee : Concerns students form non-EU/EEA countries only
For the winter semester: until 28 September 2026

notes: Tuition: EUR 1,500 per semester for non-EU/EEA students; quoted pages state this for international students at HHN. Application channel for a Moroccan applicant with a foreign diploma: the pages state foreign/non-German certificates must first be recognised by Studienkolleg Konstanz or Uni-Assist, so Uni-Assist VPD (de-uni-assist-vpd) applies. Deadline: 28 September applies; the year in the DAAD quote is 2026, while the university page says only "September 28" without a year, so the year is taken from the DAAD page. German language: no minimum level required (DAAD page).

note.fr: Votre diplôme de fin d'études secondaires doit d'abord être reconnu par le Studienkolleg Konstanz ou par Uni-Assist ; sans cette reconnaissance, votre candidature ne sera pas prise en compte.
note.en: Your school-leaving certificate must first be recognised by Studienkolleg Konstanz or by Uni-Assist; without certificate recognition, your application will not be considered.

evidence.quote: If you hold a non-German school leaving certificate, you must first have it recognized by Studienkolleg Konstanz or by Uni-Assist.
Without certificate recognition, your application will unfortunately not be considered.

note.fr: Les candidats internationaux peuvent être admis via la procédure d'examen d'entrée propre à l'université, avec des tests écrits et oraux (TestAS, ITB, SAT, ACT, IELTS, TOEFL, TestDaF, etc.) ; vérifiez si vous devez suivre cette voie.
note.en: International applicants may be admitted via the university-specific entrance examination, with written and oral tests (TestAS, ITB, SAT, ACT, IELTS, TOEFL, TestDaF, etc.); check whether you must take this route.

evidence.quote: University-specific entrance exam If you meet the requirements for attending a Studienkolleg (preparatory college) but do not wish to attend one, and instead want to choose this alternative path to HHN, please submit your certificate recognition as well as your test results in our application portal.
